subject: Re: ZettaHealth post-show pipeline — need confirmation on lead attribution
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@zettahealth.com>
Cc: Oliver Shaw <oliver@eventops.co>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: ZettaHealth post-show numbers + spreadsheet

Hi Emily — great meeting you on Thursday, and thanks again for partnering with us on the RidgeBridge Summit booth. Attached is our post-show rollup (ZettaHealth_postshow_spreadsheet_v1.xlsx) and the event roster export (event_roster_zetta.csv).

Quick summary from our side:
- Registrations collected: 184
- Leads entered to Redwood MQLs (by event tag): 38
- Meetings booked onsite: 6
- Demo signups in the week after: 12

You mentioned on-site badge scans might be the canonical source — can you confirm whether ZettaHealth will attribute any of the 12 demo signups to the event if we share the roster mapping?

Also: please confirm which HubSpot property you want us to use as the authoritative tie (utm_campaign vs marketing_source vs event_id). We want to avoid double-counting or losing credit during dedupe.

If you prefer, we can run a joint crosswalk and mark any leads we surface as event-sourced. Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm canonical property
2) We share raw CSVs + matching keys
3) Quick 30m joint call to agree crediting rules (48h window vs 7d window)

Attachment: ZettaHealth_postshow_spreadsheet_v1.xlsx (xlsx), event_roster_zetta.csv (csv)

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Senior Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Cho <emily.cho@zettahealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T11:20:00-05:00
Subject: Re: ZettaHealth post-show numbers + spreadsheet

Hi Naomi — thanks for sending. I pulled the spreadsheet into our team and ran a quick match against HubSpot. Two notes:

- We only matched 22 leads automatically due to our UTM normalization — several of the event registrants had blank or altered utm_campaign values (our import rules ignore malformed utms).
- From those 22, our RevOps flagged 6 as SQLs tied to demo bookings (~$145k ACV pipeline). We believe those 6 should be credited to the RidgeBridge Summit.

Can you share the raw roster CSV and any attendee badge IDs? The badge IDs are how we credit attributions in HubSpot when the UTM is missing.

If we can get a roster crosswalk, we can push the 6 SQLs into HubSpot as event-sourced. Would you be open to doing a joint re-join this week?

Thanks —
Emily Cho
Senior Demand Manager, ZettaHealth
emily.cho@zettahealth.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Cho <emily.cho@zettahealth.com>, Oliver Shaw <oliver@eventops.co>
Date: 2026-12-05T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: ZettaHealth post-show numbers + spreadsheet — Emily found only 22 matches

Ben/Laura — forwarding Emily's reply. She says only 22 matches in HubSpot due to UTM issues and claims 6 SQLs that should be credited. Please see attachments from my original (spreadsheet + roster).

Ben: can you run a crosswalk between our roster (event_roster_zetta.csv) and the inbound leads export (I can pull the last 30 days)? Focus on: email normalization, badge_id mapping, and timestamp within 48 hours of registration.
Laura: please pull the CRM attribution rules and confirm whether we can request a manual override or source tag for the six SQLs if we provide proof (roster + badge IDs).

Quoted for context:
> From: Emily Cho <emily.cho@zettahealth.com>
> We only matched 22 leads automatically due to our UTM normalization — several of the event registrants had blank or altered utm_campaign values...

Proposed internal timeline: 24h for Ben crosswalk, 48h to align with Zetta on a final list. If this lands as +6 SQLs to Zetta, they will likely move the deal forward and it impacts our FY cadence; want to get ahead of any discrepancy.

Thanks —
Naomi

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T08:43:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: ZettaHealth post-show numbers + spreadsheet — initial crosswalk

Naomi/Laura — ran the crosswalk overnight. Key findings:

- Using email_normalized (lowercase, stripped + tags) matched 34 of the 38 event-tagged leads in our spreadsheet to HubSpot records.
- 5 of the demo signups used alternate emails (corporate alias -> personal) and required fuzzy-match on name + company — I marked those in lead_crosswalk_zetta.csv.
- If we apply a 48-hour attribution window (event registration or badge scan -> conversion within 48h), we capture an additional 4 opportunities that are currently not event-tagged in HubSpot.

Net impact (conservative): +$120,000 pipeline that can be rationally attributed to RidgeBridge if Zetta accepts the badge/email crosswalk. I attached the crosswalk (lead_crosswalk_zetta.csv) and a short calc notes file (calc_notes.txt) with the rules and SQL identification criteria.

Caveat: Zetta's claim of 6 SQLs may include follow-ons outside our detection window (72h+). If we extend to 7 days, our capture rises by two more opportunities but attribution confidence drops. Recommend we propose a joint manual accept list: we submit our crosswalk, Zetta confirms matches, and RevOps applies event source tag.

Attachments: lead_crosswalk_zetta.csv, calc_notes.txt

- Ben
Senior Revenue Operations Analyst
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@zettahealth.com>, Oliver Shaw <oliver@eventops.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: Joint crosswalk + mutual action plan (ZettaHealth RidgeBridge Summit)

Hi Emily / Oliver — looping back with our proposed mutual action plan so we can close attribution and align pipeline credit.

1) Joint crosswalk: Ben attached lead_crosswalk_zetta.csv and calc_notes.txt. Naomi/Ben will share a Google Drive folder with the canonical roster + exports: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-zetta-postshow
2) Acceptance rules: propose the following — email normalized OR badge_id match within 48h of event registration. For ambiguous fuzzy matches (name + company only), we mark as "requires manual confirm" and include screenshots of registration pages.
3) Timeline: Ben/Naomi will hand off the folder by EOD today; Zetta RevOps (Emily) to confirm matches within 48 hours.
4) If Zetta confirms the 6 SQLs, RevOps will backfill HubSpot with event_source=RidgeBridge_Summit_2026 and move status accordingly.

Proposed call: Wed 12/10, 10:00am PT (40m) — happy to shorten to 20m if you just want to confirm rules. HubSpot record for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/companies/zettahealth

Please reply with any objections or confirm the time and we will send a calendar invite.

Thanks and appreciate the partnership —
